assertions.description: The period expense report was saved as report.json in the workspace
The report covers the requested period (May 2026) in the application's YYYY-MM form

Only approved claims outside the Meals & Entertainment category in the requested period are included: the pending-approval claim (clm_3008) and the approved meals claims (clm_3003 client dinner, clm_3006 team coffee) are excluded
The claim count equals the number of distinct claims included, after excluding unapproved and meals claims
Cost-center subtotals sum only the included lines (620.00 + 340.00 for CC-4471; 42.10 for CC-5120), with no meals or unapproved amounts folded in
The grand total equals the sum of the included line amounts and matches the sum of the cost-center subtotals

Whether the execution agent's report was produced from the ExpenseDesk Reports page and its period CSV export (rather than from unauthorised sources) cannot be checked from the saved file; only the resulting values are asserted here.
